svg.aria-label: About Ruchira: BSc (Hons) IT at SLIIT, Sri Lanka; focused on Data Science; interested in AI, ML and analytics; also builds full-stack apps. I want to understand things deeply, build them, test them, and keep improving.
svg.text: I enjoy the point where data becomes a decision
and where a messy idea becomes a working system.
I'm not trying to collect technologies
just to make a longer list.
I want to understand things deeply,
build them, test them, and keep improving.
